info.name: Ticket Management API Documentation
info.description: A versioned JSON:API style REST API for raising, assigning, filtering and resolving support tickets, secured with JWT and token abilities.

item.name: Authentication
item.description:
Register, log in, read the current user, refresh and log out. Tokens are JWTs: send them as
`Authorization: Bearer {token}` on every other request.

request.description: Creates the account and logs the user in immediately.
Returns an access token. Send it as a Bearer token on every other request.
Blacklists the current token so it can never be used again.
Returns the user that owns the Bearer token.
Blacklists the current token and returns a brand-new one.

item.name: Tickets
item.description:
Create, read, update and delete support tickets. Regular users act on the tickets they
raised; managers act on any ticket and are the only ones who can assign tickets.

query.description: Filter by status. Use a comma for several.
Filter by priority. Use a comma for several.
Search the ticket number and the title.
Filter by title. Use * as a wildcard.
Filter by ticket number. Use * as a wildcard.
Tickets raised by these user ids.
Tickets assigned to these user ids.
A date, or a range as from,to.
A date, or a range as from,to.
Sort by ticketNumber, title, status, priority, createdAt or updatedAt. Prefix with - for descending.
Include related users: author, assignee.
The page number.

request.description:
Returns a paginated list of tickets (15 per page, without descriptions). Supports filtering,
searching, sorting and including the author and assignee.

body.raw: {"data":{"attributes":{"title":"Printer on the second floor is offline","description":"The printer shows error E-104 and does not accept print jobs.","status":"open","priority":"high"},"relationships":{"author":{"data":{"id":1}},"assignee":{"data":{"id":2}}}}}

request.description:
Managers can choose any author and an assignee. Regular users can only create tickets
for themselves and cannot assign them. The ticket number is generated by the server.

item.name: User Tickets
item.description:
The tickets raised by one user: /api/v1/users/{user}/tickets. A ticket that does not
belong to the user in the URL returns 404. The same permissions apply as on /tickets.

query.description: Filter by status. Use a comma for several.
Filter by priority. Use a comma for several.
Search the ticket number and the title.
Sort by ticketNumber, title, status, priority, createdAt or updatedAt.
Include related users: author, assignee.

request.description: Lists only the tickets this user raised. Every ticket filter and sort works here too.

item.name: Users
item.description:
User management. Any logged-in user can list and view users; only managers can create,
replace, update and delete them.

query.description: Filter by name. Use * as a wildcard.
Filter by email. Use * as a wildcard.
Sort by name, email, createdAt or updatedAt. Prefix with - for descending.
Include the tickets each user raised.

request.description: Lists every user (not only authors), with the filters and sorting from the URL.
Managers only. The password is hashed before it is stored.

Managers only. The tickets the user raised are deleted with them, and tickets assigned
to them become unassigned.
